record.hypothesis: Scale input item embeddings by a fixed training-frequency feature: w(i)=clip((f(i)/median_positive_frequency)^(-0.15),0.5,2.0), with padding weight zero. Compute counts solely from each category's training interactions and save the weights for identical inference. This may reduce dominance by common history items. Preserve embedding parameters, GRU topology, readout, candidate scoring, loss and optimizer.

category_rationales.rationale: Scale history embeddings by fixed inverse-frequency weights computed solely from each category's training interactions. This may reduce dominance by frequent history items while preserving learned embeddings, GRU topology, readout, candidate scoring, loss and optimizer. A persistent buffer saves the feature weights in each checkpoint; the generated predictor imports the updated model class and restores them automatically.
